DeepCool AG400 120mm CPU Cooler

The DeepCool AG400 is a compact, single-tower air cooler designed for effective thermal performance and easy installation. It offers great value for gamers and PC builders who need solid cooling without breaking the bank.

Key Features:

  • Cooling Capacity: Up to 220W TDP
  • Heat Pipes: 4 direct-contact 6mm copper heat pipes
  • Fan Size: 120 x 120 x 25 mm
  • Fan Speed: 500–2000 RPM ±10%
  • Airflow: 75.89 CFM
  • Air Pressure: 2.53 mmAq
  • Noise Level: ≤31.6 dB(A)
  • Bearing Type: Hydro Bearing
  • Fan Connector: 4-pin PWM
  • Rated Voltage: 12V DC
  • Power Consumption: 2.04W


Compatibility:

  • Intel Sockets: LGA1700, 1200, 1151, 1150, 1155
  • AMD Sockets: AM5, AM4
  • Design and Installation:
  • Checkerboard fin-stack design for optimized airflow
  • Balanced bidirectional heat pipe technology for consistent performance
  • Fan lock mounting system allows easy installation without removing the fan
